turns.did:
WITH customer_first_order AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  GROUP BY
    customer_key
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN cfo.first_order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    THEN 'New customers (first order from 2024 onwards)'
    ELSE 'Older customers (first order before 2024)'
  END AS customer_segment,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN customer_first_order AS cfo
  ON s.customer_key = cfo.customer_key
GROUP BY
  customer_segment
ORDER BY
  customer_segment
